named-query.name: KycPayment.findByFolioWithTransactions
named-query.query: select p from KycPayment p join fetch p.transactions t where p.folio=:folio

named-query.name: KycPayment.findByFolioAndCustomer
named-query.query: select p from KycPayment p where p.folio=:folio and p.idUser=:idCustomer

named-query.name: KycPayment.findByReferenceAndCustomer
named-query.query: select p from KycPayment p where p.reference=:reference and p.idUser=:idCustomer

named-query.name: KycPayment.findPaymentsFromDate
named-query.query: select p from KycPayment p where p.datePayment>= :dateInitial and p.datePayment<= :dateFinish order by p.datePayment desc

named-query.name: KycPayment.findPaymentsFromDateAndCustomer
named-query.query: select p from KycPayment p where p.datePayment>= :dateInitial and p.datePayment<= :dateFinish and p.idCustomer=:idCustomer order by p.datePayment desc

named-query.name: KycCustomerPaymentMethod.findAllCustomerPaymentMethod
named-query.query: select p from KycCustomerPaymentMethod p where p.idCustomer=:idCustomer order by p.creationDate asc

named-query.name: KycCustomerPaymentMethod.findAuthMethodToPay
named-query.query: select p from KycCustomerPaymentMethod p where p.idCustomer=:idCustomer and p.active=true and p.authorize=true and p.idPaymentMethod=:method

named-native-query.name: KycParameter.getKey
named-native-query.query: SELECT PARAM_KEY,PARAM_VALUE FROM KYC_PARAMETERS WHERE PARAM_KEY = ?1
